description: Make plans with friends, family, co-workers or any group: create a poll of candidate dates or times, and everyone marks which ones work for them, so the group can find a date or time that works for everyone. For example a dinner, a trip, game night, a team lunch, an offsite or a meeting. Use when the user is planning something with other people and hasn't settled on a date. Returns a link to share with the group and a private link for the organizer. Pass either `dates` (all-day options) or `times` (time slots with the user's `timeZone`), all in the future. Pass `organizerName` (the user's first name) when you know it. Give the user both links: `inviteUrl` to share with the group, and `manageUrl`, which only they should have.

dates.description: All-day options as YYYY-MM-DD calendar days, up to 100. Use this or `times`, not both.

duration.description: Default length of each time slot in minutes. Defaults to 60.

location.description: Where it happens, as free text.

organizerName.description: The user's first name, if you know it. The poll shows it as the host.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone the times are in, usually the user's, like "America/New_York". Required with `times` unless every time has an offset. Each participant sees the times in their own zone.

times.description: Time slot options, up to 100. Use this or `dates`, not both.

start.description: Start as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm, like 2026-12-05T19:00. Without an offset it is wall clock time in `timeZone`.

title.description: What the event is, e.g. "Dinner with Sam and Alex".

name: create_poll

inviteUrl.description: Share this with the group. Anyone with it can vote.

manageUrl.description: Private link for the user only: opens the poll to edit it, see results and pick the final date.

start.description: Time slot start, in the poll's time zone with its offset.

weekday.description: Day of the week the option falls on, in the poll's time zone, like "Friday". Check it against what the user asked for.

title: Create a group poll
